title: AI isn't replacing SREs, it's deskilling them
why_read: A thoughtful critique of AI's effect on site reliability engineering skills that goes beyond the usual hype-versus-doom framing.
analysis: The piece argues that AI tools are not eliminating the SRE role but are instead eroding the hands-on troubleshooting skills that make a good SRE effective. This touches on a real organizational risk: if engineers lean on AI for incident response, they may lose the deep system knowledge needed when AI tools fail or produce wrong answers. It is a discussion-style piece rather than a technical deep dive, but the topic is one many engineering teams are grappling with right now. The large comment count suggests a lively debate about AI's role in operations work.
